parameters.help_en:
The notification policy. Valid values:

null: No notification policy is specified. After the alert rule is created, you can create a notification policy and specify matching rules and matching conditions (such as the alert rule name) to match this alert rule. When the alert rule is triggered and generates an alert event, the alert information is sent to the contacts or contact groups specified in the notification policy.
Notification policy ID: Specifies a notification policy. If you select this option, Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS) automatically adds a matching rule to the corresponding notification policy. The matching rule content is the alert rule ID (displayed as the alert rule name), which ensures that alert events generated by the current alert rule can be matched by the selected notification policy
parameters.help_zh:
指定通知策略。

null：不指定通知策略。当完成创建告警规则后，您可以通过新建通知策略并指定匹配规则和匹配条件（如告警规则名称等）来匹配该告警规则。当该告警规则被触发产生告警事件后，告警信息会被发送给通知策略中指定的联系人或联系人组。
通知策略ID：指定某个通知策略。若选择此项，ARMS会自动在对应的通知策略添加一条匹配规则，匹配规则内容为告警规则ID（以告警规则名称的方式呈现），以确保当前告警规则产生的告警事件一定可以被选择的通知策略匹配到

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions of the Application Monitoring or Browser Monitoring alert rule.
The format is as follows:

```
"DimFilters": [ 
{ 
 "FilterOpt": "ALL",
 "FilterValues": [],         // The filter condition value.
 "FilterKey": "rootIp"     // The filter condition key.
}
]
```
Valid values of FilterOpt:
STATIC: Matches this dimension value exactly.
ALL: Traverses all dimension values. Note: Range detection does not support traversal.
DISABLE: Aggregates all dimension values into a single value (sum)
parameters.help_zh:
应用监控或前端监控告警规则的筛选条件。
格式如下：

```
"DimFilters": [ 
{ 
 "FilterOpt": "ALL",
 "FilterValues": [],         //过滤条件Value。
 "FilterKey": "rootIp"     //过滤条件Key。
}
]
```
FilterOpt取值如下：
STATIC： 固定匹配此维度值。
ALL：遍历所有维度值。注意：区间检测不支持遍历操作。
DISABLE：聚合所有维度值为一个值（求和）
parameters.name: filters

parameters.help_en:
The alert rule content for Application Monitoring or Browser Monitoring. The AlertRuleContent template is as follows. For the description of each field in the template, see the supplementary notes below the table.

```json
{ 
    "Condition": "OR",
     "AlertRuleItems": [
             { "Operator": "CURRENT_LTE",
                 "MetricKey": "appstat.jvm.threadcount",
                 "Value": 1000,
                 "Aggregate": "AVG",
                  "N": 10,
                  "Tolerability": 169
            } 
       ]  
  }
```

Different MetricsType values support different condition fields for AlertRuleItems.MetricKey. For the metric types supported by Application Monitoring and Browser Monitoring and the alert rule fields corresponding to each metric, see the supplementary notes below the table

parameters.help_en:
The severity level of the Managed Service for Prometheus alert rule. Valid values:

P1: Used for critical issues that affect the availability of core services, have a wide impact, and may cause severe consequences.
P2: Used for issues that cause partial service errors, have a certain impact on system availability, but have a relatively limited scope of impact.
P3: Used for issues that may cause service errors or impact, or for alert notifications sent for services of relatively lower importance.
P4: Used for scenarios that require notification but have low priority and do not affect services.
Default: Use the default level if you do not need to differentiate alert severity levels
parameters.help_zh:
Prometheus告警规则的等级。

P1：一般用于影响核心业务可用性，影响范围很大，可能导致严重后果的重大问题的告警通知。
P2：一般用于部分业务出错，会对系统可用性造成一定影响，但是影响范围相对有限的问题的告警通知。
P3：一般用于对可能导致业务出错或者受影响的问题的告警通知，或者在相对重要程度较低的业务发送的告警通知。
P4： 用于需要通知，但是优先级较低，也不会对业务造成影响的场景发送告警通知。
默认：如果不需要区分告警等级，可以使用默认级别
parameters.name: level

Prometheus告警规则的等级。

P1：一般用于影响核心业务可用性，影响范围很大，可能导致严重后果的重大问题的告警通知。
P2：一般用于部分业务出错，会对系统可用性造成一定影响，但是影响范围相对有限的问题的告警通知。
P3：一般用于对可能导致业务出错或者受影响的问题的告警通知，或者在相对重要程度较低的业务发送的告警通知。
P4： 用于需要通知，但是优先级较低，也不会对业务造成影响的场景发送告警通知。
默认：如果不需要区分告警等级，可以使用默认级别
